business_problem: The startup implements services and support from Amazon Web Services (AWS) to achieve these goals.
solution_summary: As a young company with bold aspirations, CAMB.AI aims to become the first homegrown AI unicorn startup from Dubai. The startup implements services and support from Amazon Web Services (AWS) to achieve these goals. Using AWS, gained access to advanced computing resources that it used to train and deploy sophisticated models—achieving breakthrough results in speech and translation technology. Amazon EC2 P5 Instances High performance GPU-based instances for deep learning and HPC applications. Amazon S3 Amazon S3 is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance.
